# Open Mind Services Limited

> AI-powered customer experience outsourcing: omnichannel support, generative AI IVR, AI chatbots, intelligent automation, and analytics & reporting for enterprise clients.

Open Mind Services Limited (OMSL) is a BPO / customer experience outsourcing company that blends human support teams with AI automation. Core offerings:

- **Omnichannel Support Hub** — inbound calls, email, and chat handled by trained agents in one connected queue, with seamless escalation between AI and human agents.
- **Generative AI IVR** — natural-language, sentiment-aware IVR that routes calls immediately without menu trees.
- **AI Chatbots** — context-aware, memory-driven chatbots for sales, support, and scheduling across WhatsApp, web, and social.
- **Intelligent Automation** — CRM-integrated workflow automation: ticket routing, prioritization, dashboards, zero-touch lead nurturing.
- **Analytics & Reporting** — real-time dashboards connecting support and automation activity to retention, conversion, and cost.
